import re
import sys

values = {}
assignment = re.compile(r"^\s*([a-p]|TMP)\s*<-\s*([a-p]|TMP|\d+)\s*;\s*$")

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = assignment.fullmatch(line)
    if not match:
        continue

    name, source = match.groups()
    values[name] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else values[source]

names = [*("abcdefghijklmnop"), "TMP"]
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
